inclusion: All original final images. Counts are unconditional. Color swap and convergence use count-valid outputs only. Sequential splits use actual initial count and color; the same initial image is reused across target conditions.
limits: Undercount is not proof of fusion. A single image per setting. Eight seeds are the pairing units. Sign-flip results are exploratory, unadjusted multiple comparisons; non-significance is not evidence of distance equivalence. Geometry, color and identity are distinct end points.
